leadText: Red's Conkeldurr (Japanese: レッドのローブシン Red's Roubushin) is a Pokémon in the Unova region.
plainText:
Red's Conkeldurr (Japanese: レッドのローブシン Red's Roubushin) is a Pokémon in the Unova region.

==History==
===PMBW series===
Conkeldurr first appeared in The New Member is an Architect!!.

In Meeting Again! Champion Green!!, Conkeldurr meets and his for the first time.

===PMXY series===
Conkeldurr made a cameo in PMXY01.

==Personality and characteristics==
Even though Conkeldurr's strengths are unknown, he has a similar personality as Red's Pokémon.

==Trivia==
Conkeldurr is the only main walking Pokémon of Red's who was not shown using any moves.
